purpose: omega selection by best-of-N reranking over the RLSF dev slice

judge.usage_covers: this invocation only; a resumed pool paid for the rest earlier

caveats: The dev slice is held out from PPO updates only. The PEFT checkpoint sampled here was trained on all of train.jsonl, this slice included.
Dev-slice figures select the reward weights and are never reported as a result; val remains the reported split.
Rewards are group-normalized within a segment, so pool scores are comparable across omega cells only at a fixed n.
